name: Mushaf VR
summary: **Mushaf VR** brings the Mushaf Al-Madina to life in virtual reality. Settle into a bright, sunlit majlis lounge: the complete Holy Quran rests open on a wooden rehal before you, pages glowing with ornate Madinah illumination, while a giant panoramic window reveals a slowly rotating planet Earth drifting past. All 604 pages of the true Madinah pagination, rendered in clear Uthmani script. Features: Complete Quran — all 114 surahs, 6,236 verses, true 604-page Madinah layout; ornate Madinah page design with i
